1|#!/bin/bash -eu
2|
3|# This script is meant to be run by
4|# https://github.com/google/oss-fuzz/blob/master/projects/libspng/Dockerfile
5|
6|mkdir $SRC/zlib/build $SRC/libspng/build
7|cd $SRC/zlib/build
8|cmake ..
9|make -j$(nproc)
10|
11|$CC $CFLAGS -c -I$SRC/zlib/build -I$SRC/zlib \
12|    $SRC/libspng/spng/spng.c \
13|    -o $SRC/libspng/build/libspng.o \
14|
15|cp $SRC/zlib/build/libz.a $SRC/libspng/build/libz.a
16|cd $SRC/libspng/build
17|ar x libz.a
18|ar rcs libspng_static.a *.o
19|
20|$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 \
21|    $SRC/libspng/tests/spng_read_fuzzer.c \
22|    -DSPNGT_HAVE_FMEMOPEN=1 \
23|    -o $OUT/spng_read_fuzzer \
24|    $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/libspng/build/libspng_static.a $SRC/zlib/build/libz.a
25|
26|$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 -I$SRC/zlib/build -I$SRC/zlib \
27|    $SRC/libspng/tests/spng_read_fuzzer.c \
28|    -DSPNGT_HAVE_FMEMOPEN=1 \
29|    -o $OUT/spng_read_fuzzer_structure_aware \
30|    -include $SRC/fuzzer-test-suite/libpng-1.2.56/png_mutator.h \
31|    -D PNG_MUTATOR_DEFINE_LIBFUZZER_CUSTOM_MUTATOR \
32|    $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/libspng/build/libspng_static.a $SRC/zlib/build/libz.a
33|
34|$CXX $CXXFLAGS -std=c++11 \
35|    $SRC/libspng/tests/spng_write_fuzzer.c \
36|    -DSPNGT_HAVE_FMEMOPEN=1 \
37|    -o $OUT/spng_write_fuzzer \
38|    $LIB_FUZZING_ENGINE $SRC/libspng/build/libspng_static.a $SRC/zlib/build/libz.a
39|
40|
41|find $SRC/libspng/tests -name "*.png" | \
42|     xargs zip $OUT/seed_corpus.zip
43|
44|cp $SRC/libspng/tests/spng.dict $OUT/
45|
46|ln -sf $OUT/seed_corpus.zip $OUT/spng_read_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip
47|ln -sf $OUT/seed_corpus.zip $OUT/spng_read_fuzzer_structure_aware_seed_corpus.zip
48|
49|ln -sf $OUT/spng.dict $OUT/spng_read_fuzzer.dict
50|ln -sf $OUT/spng.dict $OUT/spng_read_fuzzer_structure_aware.dict
